// divguard:path agent/agent.go

package agent

import "context"

type Event struct{}

type Agent struct {
	closed  chan struct{}
	EventCh chan Event
}

// emit delivers every event and stops only when the session closes.
func (a *Agent) emit(ev Event) {
	select {
	case a.EventCh <- ev:
	case <-a.closed:
	}
}

// produce may stop on cancellation: its channel carries work, not events.
func produce(ctx context.Context, lines chan<- []byte, line []byte) {
	select {
	case lines <- line:
	case <-ctx.Done():
	}
}

// pig divergence (D56): a recorded divergence allows the drop.
func heartbeat(ctx context.Context, eventCh chan<- Event) {
	select {
	case eventCh <- Event{}:
	case <-ctx.Done():
	}
}
